meta.primaryViewport: 1168x975 CSS px, DPR 2 (in-app browser window; width fluctuated with Review pane — see responsive-breakpoints.md for controlled iframe probes)
meta.method: getComputedStyle census over every DOM node + stylesheet rule walk + Framer --token-* inline style inspection
meta.note: Every value below lists where it was observed. Counts = number of DOM elements with that computed value on the homepage at the time of the census pass.

nav-rule.usage: 1px horizontal rule under nav (framer-kum8tb-container, y44 h1 w1104)

hover-beige.usage: DOWNLOAD RESUME button background on hover (160x32 at x976 y485 on /about)

link-default.usage: computed color of anchors where Framer did not override (SERIOUS CAVEAT: this is the UA default; rendered link colors are set per-element via --framer-link-text-color — e.g. logo renders rgb(14,14,15), nav links render rgb(42,42,42)). Do not use #0000EE in the rebuild without checking the specific element.
